# Wells of Healing

> Christian healing rooms ministry in Richmond, BC, Canada offering free, walk-in, in-person prayer for physical, mental, and emotional healing. Affiliated with the International Association of Healing Rooms (IAHR).

- When: Every Thursday, 7:00–8:30 PM (Pacific time)
- Where: Room 104, 11295 Mellis Drive, Richmond, BC V6X 2R7 (Fraserview MB Church)
- Contact: wsofhealing@gmail.com
- Entrance: Back door — the same entrance as the Canadian Star Secondary School
- Appointment: Not needed — walk-ins only
- Cost: Free
- Who is welcome: People from all walks of life, no matter their background, belief, or burden
- Holiday closures: Closed Thursday, Dec 24 and Thursday, Dec 31, 2026; resumes Thursday, Jan 7, 2027
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/rnTJjTPMU88ziMQG7

- [Home](https://www.wellsofhealing.com/): About, prayer for every need, what to expect, visit details, FAQ
